
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(synExtra)
library(fst)
library(data.table)
library(powerjoin)
library(readxl)

synapser::synLogin()

syn <- synDownloader("~/data", .cache = TRUE)
```

```{r}
compound_dict <- syn("syn26260332") |>
  read_fst(as.data.table = TRUE)

compound_names <- syn("syn26260347") |>
  read_fst(as.data.table = TRUE)

canonical_names <- compound_names[
  !is.na(name), .(lspci_id, name)
][
  , head(.SD, n = 1), by = .(lspci_id)
]

compound_mapping <- syn("syn26260389") |>
  read_fst(as.data.table = TRUE)

gujral_raw <- syn("syn77547525") |>
  read_csv() |>
  mutate(
    Name = if_else(
      Name %in% c("", "-"),
      NA_character_, Name
    ) |>
      coalesce(Compound)
  )
```

```{r}
gujral_mapping_name_raw <- distinct(gujral_raw, Name) |>
  mutate(
    name_join = str_replace_all(Name, "[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "") |> str_to_lower()
  ) |>
  left_join(
    compound_names |>
      drop_na(name) |>
      mutate(name_join = str_replace(name, "[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "") |> str_to_lower()) |>
      distinct()
  )

gujral_mapping_name <- gujral_mapping_name_raw |>
  filter(!is.na(lspci_id)) |>
  group_by(Name) |>
  filter(uniqueN(lspci_id) == 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  distinct(Name, lspci_id)

gujral_raw |>
  distinct(Name) |>
  anti_join(
    gujral_mapping_name |>
      drop_na(lspci_id)
  )
```

Unmapped remain these compounds, which are not in OKL, leaving them unmapped.

```{r}
gujral_long <- gujral_raw |>
  select(-Compound) |>
  power_inner_join(
    gujral_mapping_name |>
      select(Name, lspci_id),
    by = "Name",
    check = check_specs(
      unmatched_keys_right = "warn",
      duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -c(Name, lspci_id, hmsl_id, Dose),
    names_to = "Kinase",
    values_to = "IC50"
  )

write_csv(
  gujral_long,
  "data/gujral_long.csv.gz"
)
```


```{r}
synStoreMany(
  "data/gujral_long.csv.gz",
  parentId = "syn18508401",
  forceVersion = FALSE,
  executed = "https://github.com/labsyspharm/okl-analysis/blob/main/wrangle_gujral.Rmd"
)
```
